import polars as pl


def dataframes_equal(df1: pl.DataFrame, df2: pl.DataFrame) -> bool:
    """Check if two polars DataFrames are exactly equal (same schema and values)."""
    return df1.equals(df2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Identical DataFrames
    df1 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": ["x", "y", "z"]})
    df2 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": ["x", "y", "z"]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df2))  # True

    # Different values
    df3 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 4], "b": ["x", "y", "z"]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df3))  # False

    # Different schema (column name)
    df4 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "c": ["x", "y", "z"]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df4))  # False

    # Different schema (column type)
    df5 = pl.DataFrame({"a": ["1", "2", "3"], "b": ["x", "y", "z"]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df5))  # False

    # Empty DataFrames
    df6 = pl.DataFrame({"a": pl.Int64([]), "b": pl.Utf8([])})
    df7 = pl.DataFrame({"a": pl.Int64([]), "b": pl.Utf8([])})
    print(dataframes_equal(df6, df7))  # True
